vo: Last month I stayed up till midnight for this. An RTX 3060 on Flipkart. Sixty six percent off, twenty eight thousand rupees. At twelve, it said: not available. Again.

So I started watching. On day one, eighteen of twenty two Flipkart GPU listings were stuck on Notify Me, and they were the cheap ones. Trusted Indian stores list the same card from twenty four thousand, but every one of those is out of stock. The price you can actually pay is about fifty five thousand.
So I built Asli. It's Hindi for genuine. Paste a GPU listing, and Asli tells you whether the deal is real, before you waste your night on it.

Here's the same card on Amazon, at fifty eight thousand. Nemotron 3 Ultra, served on Nebius Token Factory, reads the listing. In parallel, Tavily searches trusted Indian stores, Reddit and TechEnclave, and Asli checks real stock on each store's product page.

Verdict: overpriced. A third party seller, non returnable, above every in-stock trusted store. Every reason links to its source, and the same card is in stock at MD Computers for three and a half thousand less. That link comes from the real price table, never from the model's imagination.

Flipkart blocks servers, so Asli asks for a screenshot instead. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL reads it in about four seconds: twenty eight thousand eight hundred, an MRP of eighty six thousand, Notify Me, sold by RetailNet. Add the watch history, zero of eight checks in stock, and the verdict is likely bait.
Every listing anyone checks joins the watchlist. Asli revisits them every two hours without spending a single model token, so a listing that never becomes buyable gets caught with proof.

And I didn't guess which model to use. I measured. On twenty nine real store pages, Nano got about one answer in six wrong. Ultra, with reasoning turned off, scored ninety eight percent, and turning reasoning off cut output tokens seven times.
It's all live on the Under the hood page. A full check costs about four cents, and a hard spending cap means Asli can never run up a bill.
Asli. Check the deal, before you wait for midnight.
